fields.reasoning: The intent says the workflow names the step; a per-step key keeps the default (the failed step) for every step that sets nothing, and one rule for every retry path keeps a manual retry and the daemon's the same
fields.statement: A workflow names the step a failed run restarts at with a step key retry_from naming another step of the same workflow (prefixed like on.* targets when the workflow is included by a workflow step); a step without it restarts at itself (after the existing walk back to the wait that feeds a failed check). Every retry honours it: rhiza run resume --retry, rhiza run start on a failed change set and the daemon's
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) the conductor's ruling, not asked of the owner

fields.reasoning: The intent's 'a plan whose review-check refuses restarts at plan': the run fails at whichever review-loop step reaches its cap, so each of them must name the interview
fields.statement: The built-in plan and plan-milestone workflows set retry_from = "interview" on every step of their review loop (review, has-findings, critic, fresh, check, revise, rulings, apply-rulings), so a plan whose review-check refuses is retried from its interview, which is the plan step of a workflow that includes it (plan-bug's plan/interview)
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) the conductor's ruling, not asked of the owner

fields.reasoning: The owner picked 'Right step + findings': the next attempt must see why the last one failed; brief.md is the file every step session already reads
fields.statement: Every agent step session started after a run's last retried entry gets a Previous attempt section in brief.md: the failed step, its outcome, its cause or output tail (as a hand-back reads them, run.CauseOf) and the findings of the latest round recorded before the retry, each with check, severity and text; the retried entry journals the failed step so the brief can name it. Spawned children's briefs are their caller's and are not changed
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) the conductor's ruling, not asked of the owner

fields.reasoning: The intent's 'once by default, then the inbox'; a watchdog setting beside retryBudget follows how every other watchdog limit is set per machine and project
fields.statement: The watchdog retries a failed run whose failure the classifier calls real (or cannot judge) with rhiza run resume --retry, up to a new watchdog setting failedRetries (rhiza.daemon.watchdog.failedRetries and rhiza.project.watchdog.failedRetries, default 1, 0 turns it off), under the same enabled and autonomousOnly rules as its other passes; transient failures keep their own retryBudget. Each retry is journalled as a watchdog attempt; once failedRetries are spent the run stays failed and goes to the inbox, its item naming the retries tried, and the inbox lists no failed run while a retry is still due
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) the conductor's ruling, not asked of the owner

fields.acceptance: Tests in internal/workflow parse a step with retry_from and an included workflow whose retry_from comes out prefixed (plan/interview); (failure case) retry_from naming no step of the workflow, or itself, is refused at parse with the step and key named; rhiza workflow describe shows the key (a cmd/rhiza testscript or the describe test); internal/guide/text/workflow-keys.md and docs/reference/workflow-file.md document it. Run: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/workflow/... and the touched testscript
fields.files: internal/workflow/workflow.go, internal/workflow/include.go, internal/workflow/workflow_test.go, internal/workflow/include_test.go, internal/api/workflow*.go (describe only), internal/guide/text/workflow-keys.md, docs/reference/workflow-file.md, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/workflow-describe*.txtar
fields.must_not: Change how a run retries (the engine leaf does); change any built-in workflow file; change other step keys
fields.statement: A workflow step may set retry_from, the step of the same workflow a failed run restarts at when it fails at this step; it parses, is prefixed like on.* targets when its workflow is included by a workflow step, is validated, shown by rhiza workflow describe and documented

fields.acceptance: Tests in internal/run fail a run at a step with retry_from and see the retried entry name the restart step and the failed step and the next visit enter the restart step with its max_visits counted afresh; a test fails a plan-bug-shaped run (a workflow step including plan) at plan/check over its cap and sees the retry enter plan/interview; (failure case) a step without retry_from still restarts at itself and a failed check fed by a wait still re-waits (RetryStep's existing tests pass unchanged); a test in internal/workflow asserts every review-loop step of the built-in plan and plan-milestone sets retry_from = interview. Run: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/run/... ./internal/workflow/... and cmd/rhiza TestScripts/run-resume-retry
fields.files: internal/run/engine.go, internal/run/journal.go, internal/run/engine_test.go, internal/run/journal_test.go, internal/workflow/builtin/plan.toml, internal/workflow/builtin/plan-milestone.toml, internal/workflow/workflow_test.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/run-resume-retry.txtar
fields.must_not: Change the brief (the brief leaf does) or the watchdog; change any review-loop step's on.* routing or max_visits; change ship-change
fields.statement: Retrying a failed run (run.Engine.Retry, so rhiza run resume --retry, rhiza run start on a failed change set and the daemon) restarts it at the failed step's retry_from when set, else where it does today; the retried entry also journals the failed step; the built-in plan and plan-milestone workflows set retry_from = "interview" on their review-loop steps

fields.acceptance: Tests in internal/run render a brief with a previous attempt (step, outcome, output tail, findings with check, severity and text) and one without it unchanged byte for byte; a test in internal/api (scoped with -run) retries a run failed at a review-check-shaped command step after a findings round and sees the restarted agent step's brief.md hold the refusal's output and the round's findings; (failure case) a run never retried, and a session started before the retry, get no such section. Run: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/run/... and go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run <the new tests>
fields.files: internal/run/brief.go, internal/run/brief_test.go, internal/run/journal.go, internal/api/run_brief.go, internal/api/run_brief_test.go, internal/guide/text/contract.md
fields.must_not: Change handback.md or a spawned child's brief; write anything into .rhiza/log; change where a retry restarts
fields.statement: Every agent step session started after a run's last retried entry finds a Previous attempt section in its brief.md: the failed step, outcome, cause or output tail and the findings of the latest round recorded before the retry

fields.acceptance: Tests in internal/api (scoped with -run) give the watchdog a failed autonomous run classified real and see one resume with --retry and an attempt charged, then a second failure of the same run left unretried and listed in rhiza inbox with the retry named; failedRetries 0 retries nothing; the inbox leaves out a failed run with a retry due; a transient failure still uses retryBudget; a test of the measure fails a plan run at review-check, sees the daemon's retry restart at interview with the refusal in the brief, and a second failure reach the inbox; (failure case) an attended run under autonomousOnly, a live or abandoned run and a disabled watchdog are never retried; the setting is listed by rhiza daemon settings (watchdog-policy testscript) and documented. Run: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run 'Watchdog|Inbox' and cmd/rhiza TestScripts/watchdog-policy
fields.files: internal/api/daemon_watchdog.go, internal/api/watchdog_policy.go, internal/api/inbox.go, internal/api/daemon_watchdog_test.go, internal/api/inbox_test.go, internal/daemon/state.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/watchdog-policy.txtar, docs/reference/config.md, docs/runs-and-daemon.md
fields.must_not: Change the failure classifier or its prompt; change the stalled-step or CI passes' budgets; retry an abandoned, live or attended (under autonomousOnly) run
fields.statement: The daemon's watchdog retries a failed run whose failure is real or unjudged with rhiza run resume --retry up to failedRetries (default 1), journalling each as a watchdog attempt; once they are spent the run goes to the inbox with the retries tried, and no failed run is in the inbox while a retry is still due
